status: draft: the numbers are sensible starting points, to be tuned with real calls; labels await native review
note: Defaults per business type (the pack code). The first key is the default for a code that is not listed. The numbers are data, not code. A school never makes sales calls and never calls about dues or fees.

voicemail_actions.label: Hang up
voicemail_actions.description: End the call and count it as no answer.

voicemail_actions.label: Leave a short message
voicemail_actions.description: Say who is calling and that you will try again. Never says prices or amounts.

voicemail_actions.label: Try again later
voicemail_actions.description: Hang up and call again by the 'no answer' rule.

phone_menu_actions.label: Hang up
phone_menu_actions.description: A phone menu ('press 1 for...') is not a person.

phone_menu_actions.label: Try again later
phone_menu_actions.description: Hang up and call again by the 'no answer' rule.

sensitivities.label: Low
sensitivities.description: Finishes its sentence unless the customer keeps talking.

sensitivities.label: Medium
sensitivities.description: Stops when the customer clearly starts to speak.

sensitivities.label: High
sensitivities.description: Stops at the first sound; best for quick, impatient callers.

purposes.label: Follow up an enquiry or quote
Remind about an event or holiday
